sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) BETWEEN $3::float8 AND $4::float8), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) = $3::float8), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) > $5::float8), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) >= $3::float8), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) = ANY($6::float8[])), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) < $7::float8), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) <= $8::float8), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) <> $9::float8), false) AND COALESCE(((SELECT count(*)::float8 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text) <> ALL($10::float8[])), false)))
